expect: (() => { const menu = document.querySelector('.sm-menu-layer:not(.sm-menu-layer--leaving) .sm-menu'); const panel = document.querySelector('.shell__sidebar'); if (!menu || !panel) return 'no menu open'; const m = menu.getBoundingClientRect(), p = panel.getBoundingClientRect(); if (m.right < p.right + 24) return 'the menu does not reach over the content (' + Math.round(m.right) + ' < ' + Math.round(p.right + 24) + ')'; const points = [[m.right - 6, m.top + m.height / 2]]; for (const item of menu.querySelectorAll('.sm-menu-item')) { const b = item.getBoundingClientRect(); points.push([p.right + 10, b.top + b.height / 2], [b.right - 8, b.top + b.height / 2]); } const missed = points.filter(([x, y]) => !document.elementFromPoint(x, y)?.closest('.sm-menu')).map(([x, y]) => Math.round(x) + ',' + Math.round(y)); return missed.length === 0 || 'not the menu at ' + missed.join(' '); })()
